title: Product for two nested subsets
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite type, let $A,B\subseteq\iota$ with $A\subseteq B$, and let $a,b$ be real numbers. The product over $i\in\iota$ of $a$ for $i\in A$, $b$ for $i\in B\setminus A$, and $1$ otherwise is $a^{|A|}b^{|B|-|A|}$.
hypotheses_covered: A and B are subsets of the index type
a and b are real numbers
